environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB (scheme=internal). The ALB's target group health check hits /health. An API Gateway (REST, regional) with a usage plan fronts the ALB via VPC Link (private integration). The API Gateway resource /api/users/search has request validation enabled with a request validator that requires the 'username', 'role', and 'email' parameters to each match the regex pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9.@_-]{0,64}$ (configured via a JSON Schema model on the Method Request's URL Query String Parameters with 'Required: false' but pattern-constrained). The API Gateway returns 400 before the request reaches the application if any provided query parameter fails validation. Additionally, the Fargate task role has no network egress (VPC with no NAT gateway, no IGW, interface endpoints only for ECR/logs/secretsmanager), and the task's security group only allows inbound from the ALB's security group on port 8080.

config.api_gateway: Regional REST API with VPC Link private integration
config.network_egress: No NAT, no IGW, interface endpoints only (ecr, logs, secretsmanager)
config.task_sg_ingress: TCP/8080 from ALB security group only
config.direct_access: Not possible - ALB is internal, only reachable via API Gateway VPC Link
